title: pcell-mwall-b42 controls: the M layer needs its adsorption drift (matched diffusion-only twin chim=0: M rim/core 0.98, 0/324 membrane-like, life cycle unchanged) and survives a 1.5x resolution continuation (M 4.46, 12 persistent splits, generation 4); adding the M particle gate to b42 freezes division
summary: Controls for my claim 20261025T1430-c14-pcell-mwall-b42-claim. (1) Matched twin: the same world, seeds 0 and 1, with M's drift up the wall indicator removed (chim 4 -> 0), so M is made by the catalyst and moves only by phi^2-gated diffusion. The layer vanishes (labkit M rim/core 0.98/0.975, peak at rho 0.25-0.35 inside the cell, 0/150 and 0/174 individuals membrane-like, against 3.87/3.91 and 142/150, 170/174 in the claim packs), while cells, splits and generation are unchanged (17 and 10 persistent splits, generation 4 and 3) because M feeds back on nothing. The wall layer is therefore made by the adsorption drift, not by production or gated diffusion. (2) Resolution: at 192^2 with all lengths x1.5 and diffusivities x2.25 (seed 4), 25-31 bounded cells form from noise and divide (12 persistent splits, generation 4, 0 merges), M rim/core 4.46, rim/out 20.7, 153/157 membrane-like, L 1.59 (pack_res15/seed4). (3) Making M also gate the particles in this world freezes it: mbeta 4 gives 0-1 persistent splits in 100000 t (2 seeds), and screens at fixed yield (data/gate_screens.txt) show that at mbeta 2 b=0.05 still gives one domain-filling cell at y=1.2 and b=0.046 gives no division at y=1.0, so no gated setting tried keeps both bounded size and division over the yield range.
